datpkgr — app-agnostic package manager library

Single LocalDriver rooted at ~/.<appName> (via DatpkgrConfig). Filesystem abstracted via flysystem. Language-agnostic manifest: configure the main entry via cfg.manifestParser / cfg.manifestFinder / cfg.manifestFileName.
